title: 第一章 愚者
slug: 这个文字冒险游戏绝对有毒
content_zh:
K市开发区，奇趣宠物店门前。
沐游将手里的大号犬笼塞进面包车后备箱里。
“师傅，这是最后一笼，运费之后打给你。”
“没问题，沐老板，以后再有猫狗出售，随时联系我啊！”
“好。”
目送着司机师傅载着一车猫猫狗狗离开，沐游回过头，望向身后空了一大半的宠物店，默默的点了支烟。
两年前，他的父母遭遇车祸离世，留给了他这家宠物店。
为了完成父母的心愿，他专门辞了工作，回老家全心经营店铺，希望能把宠物店再做起来。
只可惜时代变化太快，疫情的冲击之下，现在做实体业的都成了地狱难度。
从几个星期前开始，宠物店经营就已经入不敷出，一天的收入甚至连饲料钱都补不上，无奈之下，他不得不出售了店里所有的猫狗，准备转行做成本更低的花鸟鱼虫店。
“希望能好转过来吧。”
掐灭了烟，沐游转身回到店里。
刚进门，就看到一个扎着马尾，围着围裙的女孩站在前台，望着店里一排排的空笼子发呆。
“怎么了，小雅？”
女孩叫做沈雅，是宠物店现在唯一的员工。
“老板……”小雅看向沐游，欲言又止：“咱们的店，不会就要这么倒闭了吧……”
“说什么呢？”
沐游手指在她脑袋上敲了下，好笑道：“只是收缩经营范围而已。”
看着女孩抱着额头委屈的样子，沐游叹了口气。
小雅是当初父母开店的时候招聘的员工，满打满算已经在店里干了整整四年。

其他员工这半年来陆陆续续都辞职了，只有她还一直坚守着。
要论对这家宠物店的感情，小雅绝不比自己差。
“放心吧，除非真到了走投无路，我是不会把店卖掉的。”
这店铺是父母留给他的念想，更是陪伴着他长大的地方，沐游当然不会轻易让它关门。
更何况，他又不是只做线下。
他在各大主流视频网站都经营有自媒体账号，靠着经常发一些宠物视频，每个月也有一份不菲的收入，要撑下去并不难。
“哦哦，那就好！”
小雅这才笑逐颜开：“我去给乌龟洗背了！”
目送这个呆萌的员工跑进宠物洗浴室，沐游走进店里，目光扫过前台，忽然一愣。
“小雅，前台的u盘是你的吗？”
“u盘？不是啊！”洗浴间传来女孩疑惑的声音。
“难道是客人遗落的？”
沐游也没多想，准备将U盘放进失物招领箱。
不过拿起U盘后，却发现下面还垫着一张纸条。
看着纸条上文字，沐游愣了一下。
什么意思？这U盘是专门给他的？
好奇之下，他坐回前台，将U盘插进电脑接口。
一个名为‘愚者（内测版本2.41）’的APP文件，以及一个TXT格式的‘游戏邀请码’。
“手游？”
沐游脸色古怪。

现在的手游为了宣传都这么拼的嘛，下载手游附送U盘？
带着好奇，他
熟练的安装，注册。
随后输入激活码，开启游戏。
想象中激昂的背景音乐和精美的游戏CG画面并没有出现。
反而是一个简陋到极点的方框界面弹出。
没有画面，也没有声音，只有一个个黑底白面的文字，仿佛对面有人笨拙的敲打一般，一个个的弹上屏幕。
【雪夜，你在一片大雪覆盖的森林中醒来。】
【寒风在林间呼啸，猫头鹰的叫声此起彼伏，清冷的月光洒落脚下，周围的每一颗枯树，就像是长了一张扭曲拗哭的脸。】
【雪花飘落的景象中，你渐渐回忆起了那些曾经被你遗忘的过往。】
【这里是名为‘星灵界’的魔法世界，狼人，吸血鬼，精灵，女巫，骑着扫把的巫师，没有心的铁皮人，会说话的镜子，古堡中的幽灵……这些传说中的魔法生物，共同组成了这个诡谲黑暗的世界。】
【很久以前，你们也是这片大陆的居民。但因为你们的先祖没有释放魔法的能力，被巫师们戏称为‘愚者’。】
【高傲的巫师协会拒绝与愚者同处一片天地，他们发动了战争，收拢了魔力，筑起了‘高墙’，隔绝了愚昧与真知。一场一忘皆空的大雨，消弭了你们的记忆，你们被永远的封锁在了没有魔力的遗忘之地。】
【现在，你侥幸穿过‘墙’的裂隙，重回了这片故土。】
【在这里，你是被厌恶之人，被这个世界所不容。接下来你的每一步，都需要小心翼翼，你做出的每一个选择，都会直接影响你的命运……】
【如果你确定准备好了面对这一切，那么，便点下开始，正式踏上这场旅行吧！】
【点击‘开始’，进入游戏。】
“原来‘愚者’是这个意思……”
沐游有些意外。
他还以为游戏名中的‘愚者’，是指代游戏中的某样事物，结果看了背景介绍才知道，愚者居然是指代玩家。

别说，这游戏外观框架虽然设计的很简陋，但故事的世界观塑造的却挺宏大，寥寥几句话，便给他展示出了一个诡谲黑暗的魔法世界。
玩家们意外闯入这个世界，接下来要在这里探险、寻宝，并向曾经驱逐了他们的巫师协会复仇！
“开始！”
沐游点下按钮。
【风雪的掩映下，你正式踏上了故乡的土地。】
【但你的身上散发着浓重的‘放逐者’的气息，为了避免被这里的原住民发现异常，你需要尽快伪装成这个世界居民的样子。】
【你的面前出现了一个漂浮的礼盒。】
【这是愚者的先祖，为每个归乡者准备的礼物，气息，以避免你被其他巫师发现。是否立即
两个选项，是，否。
“这应该算是新手礼包吧？”
沐游想着，默默点下了【是】。
【先祖遗物抽取中……】
【抽取完成！】
【你获得了‘时光怀表（隐藏）’：按下怀表，可以将时间回溯，帮你躲过那些隐藏在暗处的危险。】
【注意：抽取遗物时，有千分之一的概率抽中效果强大的唯一性隐藏遗物。】
“隐藏遗物？”
看着文本提示沐游不由一愣。
只有千分之一抽取的概率，居然被他一发抽中了……看来今天运气不错！
……当然，也有可能是每个人的第一抽都是保底隐藏，氪金手游的常规套路了。
不管如何吧，这虽然是个‘小破文字游戏’，但其庞大的世界观，和这种通过文字探险寻宝的特殊游戏模式，都让沐游有了继续玩下去的动力。

点击屏幕，沐游正打算继续，却忽然感觉右手中冰凉一片，似乎握住了什么东西。
低头一看，一枚圆形的小巧怀表安静的躺在他手心。
铜质的外壳，白色的表盘，顶端一个突出的按钮，按钮上固定了一条金色的链子。
沐游奇怪的看着手中的怀表。
这哪来的？
他不记得家里有这种老式怀表，况且，一块表怎么会忽然跑进手里？
“老板你是在看手相吗？”
耳边忽然响起声音。
抬头一看，小雅不知道什么时候走了过来，正趴在前台桌上，双手托着腮帮，好奇看着他摊开的手掌。
“看手相？”
沐游听到她这个问题，心里忽然冒出一个奇怪的念头。
“小雅，难道你看不到这块表？”
“表？什么表？”
“就我手里的怀表啊！”
沐游还特意将怀表提起来，给她展示。
“老、老板你别吓我……你手里明明什么都没有……”
小雅见鬼一样看着他，下意识的往后退了一步，结果胳膊不小心碰到了桌边的水杯。
水杯摔落而下，小雅急忙想要挽救，但为时已晚。
“呯！”
装满水的玻璃杯摔得粉碎，玻璃渣子和茶水溅落一地。

“啊，对不起……”小雅满脸羞愧，下意识就要去捡玻璃渣子。
“一个杯子而已……”
沐游刚想摆手说没事，结果手指却是鬼使神差的按在了怀表按钮上。
下一瞬，他只感觉眼前光线一闪，周围的一切忽然开始极速倒带。
覆水能收，破杯重圆！
待一切平静下来，再睁眼看去的时候。
地上的碎片和水渍消失的无影无踪。
碎裂的水杯，原封不动的回到了桌上。
他右手则保持着捏着怀表展示的动作。
而前方的小雅，也重新站在了前台桌边，正一脸见鬼的看着他。
“老、老板你别吓我……你手里明明什么都没有……”
熟悉的对话响起，沐游呆愣当场：什么情况？我在做梦？
结果下一秒，小雅手肘又一次碰到水杯，水杯再次直落而下。
沐游的瞳孔收缩，右手闪电般的探出，险险接住了飞在半空的水杯。
“啊！”
小雅惊呼一声，看着被沐游接住的杯子，心有余悸的拍了拍胸脯：“还好老板你反应快，差一点打碎了。”
“……”
沐游却没有接话，而是有些震惊的看着手里的杯子。
同样的场景，他居然经历了两次，而且还改变了结果……
他下意识的又看向手机屏幕。

此时游戏界面中，一道新的提示已经弹出。
【时光怀表：被时光仙女祝福过的怀表，按下按钮，可逆转时间，回溯到五秒之前，每次使用后有五秒的冷却。】
content_en:
K City Development Zone, in front of Funny Pet Store.
Mu You stuffed the large dog cage in his hand into the trunk of the van.
"Master, this is the last cage. I will call you after the shipping fee."
"No problem, Boss Mu. If you have cats and dogs for sale in the future, please contact me anytime!"
"Okay."
Watching the driver leave with a car full of cats and dogs, Mu You turned around, looked at the mostly empty pet shop behind him, and silently lit a cigarette.
Two years ago, his parents died in a car accident and left him this pet shop.
In order to fulfill his parents' wish, he quit his job and returned to his hometown to run the store full-time, hoping to start a pet store again.
It's a pity that times are changing too fast. Under the impact of the epidemic, it has become hellish for those in the real industry.
Since a few weeks ago, the pet store has been unable to make ends meet. One day's income can't even make up for the feed. In desperation, he had to sell all the cats and dogs in the store and prepare to switch to a lower-cost flower, bird, fish and insect shop.
"Hopefully things will get better."
After putting out the cigarette, Mu You turned around and returned to the store.
As soon as I walked in, I saw a girl with a ponytail and an apron standing at the front desk, staring blankly at the rows of empty cages in the store.
"What's wrong, Xiaoya?"
The girl's name is Shen Ya, and she is the only employee of the pet shop.
"Boss..." Xiaoya looked at Muyou and hesitated: "Our store will close down like this..."
"What did you say?"
Mu You tapped her head with his finger and said amusedly: "It's just a contraction of the business scope."
Seeing the girl holding her forehead in grievance, Mu You sighed.
Xiaoya was an employee recruited by her parents when they opened the store, and she has been working in the store for four full years.
Other employees have resigned one after another in the past six months, but she is the only one who has stayed on.
When it comes to her feelings for this pet shop, Xiaoya is by no means worse than herself.
"Don't worry, I won't sell the store unless I'm really desperate."
This shop was a memory left to him by his parents, and it was a place where he grew up. Of course, Mu You would not let it close easily.
What's more, he doesn't only do offline work.
He operates self-media accounts on major mainstream video websites. He earns a lot of income every month by posting pet videos frequently, so it is not difficult to sustain it.
"Oh, that's good!"
Xiaoya then smiled and said, "I'm going to wash the turtle's back!"
Watching this cute employee run into the pet bathroom, Mu You walked into the store, glanced at the front desk, and was suddenly stunned.
"Xiaoya, is the USB flash drive at the front desk yours?"
"USB disk? No!" The girl's confused voice came from the bathroom.
"Did the guests leave it behind?"
Muyou didn't think much and was about to put the USB flash drive into the lost and found box.
But after picking up the USB flash drive, I found a note underneath.
Looking at the words on the note, Mu You was stunned for a moment.
What's the meaning? Is this USB flash drive just for him?
Out of curiosity, he sat back at the front desk and inserted the USB flash drive into the computer interface.
An APP file named ‘The Fool (internal beta version 2.41)’, and a ‘game invitation code’ in TXT format.
"Mobile game?"
Mu You looked strange.
Is it true that mobile games these days work so hard for promotion? Does downloading a mobile game come with a USB flash drive?
Out of curiosity, he
Skilled installation and registration.
Then enter the activation code to start the game.
The exciting background music and exquisite game CG graphics did not appear.
Instead, an extremely crude box interface popped up.
There was no picture or sound, just text with black background and white surface, as if someone was clumsily tapping on the opposite side, they popped up on the screen one by one.
[On a snowy night, you wake up in a forest covered with heavy snow. 】
[The cold wind howls in the forest, the hoots of owls come and go, and the cool moonlight shines onWhen I fell down, every dead tree around seemed to have a twisted and crying face. 】
[In the scene of falling snowflakes, you gradually recall the past that you have forgotten. 】
[This is a magical world called the "Star Spirit World". Werewolves, vampires, elves, witches, wizards riding broomsticks, heartless tin men, talking mirrors, ghosts in the castle... These legendary magical creatures together form this strange and dark world. 】
[A long time ago, you were also residents of this continent. But because your ancestors did not have the ability to release magic, they were nicknamed 'fools' by wizards. 】
[The proud Wizards Association refused to coexist with fools. They launched a war, collected magic power, and built a "high wall" to isolate ignorance and true knowledge. A heavy rain that wipes out all your memories, and you are forever sealed in a forgotten land without magic. 】
[Now, you luckily passed through the crack in the 'wall' and returned to this homeland. 】
[Here, you are a hated person and are not tolerated by this world. Every step you take next, you need to be careful, every choice you make will directly affect your destiny...]
[If you are sure you are ready to face all this, then click Start and officially embark on this journey! 】
[Click ‘Start’ to enter the game. 】
"So this is what 'fool' means..."
Mu You was a little surprised.
He thought that the "Fool" in the game's name referred to something in the game, but after reading the background introduction, he realized that the "Fool" actually refers to the player.
Needless to say, although the appearance of this game is very simple, the world view of the story is quite grand. In just a few sentences, it shows him a strange and dark magical world.
Players accidentally broke into this world, and next they have to explore, hunt for treasures, and take revenge on the Wizards Association that once expelled them!
"Start!"
Muyou clicked the button.
[Under the cover of wind and snow, you officially set foot on the land of your hometown. 】
[But you exude a strong aura of an 'exile'. In order to avoid being discovered by the indigenous people here, you need to disguise yourself as a resident of this world as soon as possible. 】
[A floating gift box appears in front of you. 】
[This is the gift and breath prepared by the ancestors of the Fool for every returnee to prevent you from being discovered by other wizards. Whether immediately
Two options, yes and no.
"This should be considered a gift package for newbies, right?"
Mu You thought and silently clicked [Yes].
[Ancestral relics are being drawn...]
[Extraction completed! 】
[You have obtained the ‘Time Pocket Watch (Hidden)’: Press the pocket watch to go back in time, helping you avoid dangers hidden in the dark. 】
[Note: When drawing relics, there is a one-thousandth chance of drawing a unique hidden relic with powerful effects. 】
"Hidden relics?"
Mu You couldn't help but be stunned when he saw the text prompt.
There was only one thousandth chance of drawing, but he actually got it with one shot... It seemed like he was lucky today!
...Of course, it’s also possible that everyone’s first draw is guaranteed to be hidden, which is a regular routine in krypton gold mobile games.
No matter what, although this is a "little word game", its huge world view and this special game mode of treasure hunting through text exploration give Muyou the motivation to continue playing.
Clicking on the screen, Mu You was about to continue, but suddenly felt something cold in his right hand, as if he was holding something.
Looking down, he saw a small, round pocket watch lying quietly in his hand.
It has a copper shell, a white dial, and a protruding button on the top, with a golden chain fixed on the button.
Mu You looked at the pocket watch in his hand strangely.
Where did this come from?
He didn't remember having this kind of old-fashioned pocket watch at home. Besides, how could a watch suddenly come into the house?In hand?
"Boss, are you reading your palm?"
There was a sudden sound in my ears.
Looking up, Xiaoya came over at some point and was lying on the front desk, holding her chin in her hands and looking curiously at his open palms.
"Palm reading?"
When Mu You heard her question, a strange thought suddenly came to his mind.
"Xiaoya, can't you see this watch?"
"Watch? What watch?"
"It's just the pocket watch in my hand!"
Mu You also deliberately lifted the pocket watch and showed it to her.
"Old, boss, don't scare me...you obviously have nothing in your hand..."
Xiaoya looked at him as if she had seen a ghost, and subconsciously took a step back. As a result, her arm accidentally touched the water glass on the table.
The water glass fell and Xiaoya hurriedly tried to save it, but it was too late.
"Bang!"
The glass filled with water shattered, and glass shards and tea splashed all over the floor.
"Ah, I'm sorry..." Xiaoya's face was full of shame, and she subconsciously wanted to pick up the glass shards.
"It's just a cup..."
Mu You just wanted to wave his hand and say it was okay, but his finger accidentally pressed the pocket watch button.
The next moment, he felt a flash of light in front of his eyes, and everything around him suddenly began to rewind at a rapid speed.
Cover with water and you will be able to collect it, and the broken cup will be reunited!
When everything calms down, you can open your eyes again.
The debris and water stains on the ground disappeared without a trace.
The broken water glass returned to the table intact.
His right hand kept holding the pocket watch to show off.
In front of her, Xiaoya stood at the front desk again, looking at him with a ghostly look on her face.
"Old, boss, don't scare me...you obviously have nothing in your hand..."
A familiar conversation rang out, and Mu You was stunned on the spot: What's going on? Am I dreaming?
As a result, the next second, Xiaoya's elbow touched the water glass again, and the water glass fell straight down again.
Mu You's pupils shrank, and his right hand reached out like lightning, narrowly catching the water glass flying in the air.
"Ah!"
Xiaoya exclaimed, looking at the cup caught by Mu You, and patted her chest with lingering fear: "Fortunately, boss, you reacted quickly, you almost broke it."
"..."
Mu You did not answer, but looked at the cup in his hand in shock.
He actually experienced the same scene twice, and the outcome changed...
He subconsciously looked at the phone screen again.
At this time, a new prompt has popped up in the game interface.
[Time Pocket Watch: A pocket watch blessed by the Time Fairy. Pressing the button can reverse time to five seconds ago. There is a five-second cooldown after each use. 】
